subject: Reprioritizing our inference pilot — demo on hold
messages:
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@novaplate.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Reprioritizing our inference pilot — demo on hold

Tessa — thanks again for the time last week and for the tailored agenda. I wanted to be upfront: our leadership just completed a roadmap replan and the platform team is being asked to prioritize a core platform migration for Q3. That means any new ML pilots (including inference work) are being paused for the next two quarters.

I know we had a demo slot on 6/17 — please go ahead and cancel on our side. Wed like to keep the conversation warm but won't be able to move forward on the pilot until the migration is complete. Can we plan a lightweight check-in for late Q3 (around Oct) instead?

Also attaching a short snapshot of our roadmap so you have context. If youd like to propose a condensed follow-up thats just an executive sync (15 min) instead of a full demo, that might be easier for us to take.

Appreciate the flexibility — Alicia
Product Lead, Novaplate

Attachment: Novaplate_Roadmap_Snapshot_Q3.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@novaplate.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 16:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reprioritizing our inference pilot — demo on hold

Thanks for the heads up, Alicia — and totally understand. Appreciate the roadmap snapshot, thats helpful context.

Short plan from our side: well cancel the 6/17 demo and put Novaplate on our nurture track. Ill also schedule a tentative 15-minute executive sync for the first week of October (no meeting will be confirmed until you give the go-ahead). If anything shifts earlier on your side, we can re-open the demo window.

Two quick asks:
- Can you confirm who on the Novaplate exec/product team we should include for an Oct sync (names/emails)?
- Would you like us to keep the security questionnaire and SOW draft on file or archive them for now? We can re-issue a refreshed SOW when youre ready.

Well also mark the deal as "on hold (roadmap)" in our CRM and set a reminder for Sept to check in.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 45KB)

Looping in a quick internal note so were aligned on next steps.

Tessa — good catch on the nurture track. A couple of practical items:
1) Mark the opportunity NV-2027-1174 as "hold: roadmap" in HubSpot and set the next task for 2027-09-20 (owner: Tessa).
2) Keep the security questionnaire in our shared drive but remove it from the active outreach packet — theres no point pushing that to Novaplate until they re-open.
3) Offer a short executive sync in Oct as you suggested; aim for a 15-minute slot with product exec + CTO. If we offer to keep a 1-page note on cost/latency benefits (customized to their platform migration constraints), that might keep interest warm without burdening their team.

Marissa — can you prepare a crisp one-pager (bullet points + 2 visuals) focused on: expected latency improvements for batch inference, estimated cost delta for initial pilot vs. production, and a 3-line note on our fallback plan (dedicated vs. hosted) for regulated workloads? Low-fidelity is fine — think executive one-pager.

If Novaplate asks for credits or pilot concessions once they re-engage, we should surface that to ops early. For now, we keep it simple and light.

—Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
